FAQ:
What services does Dr. Nour Veterinary Center for Animal Medicine and Surgery provide?
Dr. Nour Veterinary Center for Animal Medicine and Surgery offers a comprehensive range of specialized medical services for pets. These services include:
Comprehensive medical examinations to assess your pet's health and diagnose diseases.
Microsurgical procedures for pets, such as neutering and tumor removal.
Digital X-rays and veterinary ultrasound to examine internal injuries and diseases.
Measuring ovulation rates in pets and providing mating consultations.
Advanced laboratory tests to detect health problems.
Dental cleaning services using specialized equipment.
Hotel accommodation and pet care.
Vaccinations and medications necessary to maintain your pet's health.
Does Dr. Nour Veterinary Center provide treatment services for large animals such as horses?
Dr. Nour Veterinary Center for Animal Medicine and Surgery specializes in the care of companion animals such as dogs and cats. It does not provide services for larger animals such as horses or cattle. The center focuses on diseases and injuries related to companion animals and their veterinary medicine.
